name: 马略
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_三_帝国.md:191
who: Marius, a human man of thirty-four, a guard of the sky city's halls: tall, about 187 cm, broad-shouldered, his back as straight as a post from ten years of standing in corridors. Silver-grey hair cropped close to the scalp, a square face shaved clean, amber eyes always lowered, looking at people's feet first. A hard callus across the web of his right hand (on the viewer's left when they face us) from ten years of a halberd. A stern, silent, exact air. No glasses.
build: 187 cm, tall and straight, broad shoulders and strong arms.
palette: white and cold pale silver, ring-of-fire gold, amber
casual: The palace guard's white plate armour, its surface engraved with a ring of fire crossed by two keys, a white tabard, white gloves; a ring of keys at his belt. He holds a halberd upright in his right hand, its head sheathed in pale silver. His helm is under his left arm; a stern, lowered look.
private: Off duty: a loose white linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, a plain grey wool vest, dark trousers and soft shoes. He holds the ring of keys in one hand; a quiet, unreadable half-smile.
battle: Ready on guard: the white plate armour with the engraved emblem, the helm on with the visor up, white gauntlets. He holds the halberd in both hands, levelled forward, feet planted wide; a hard, immovable look.
formal: For the feast: the white plate polished to a mirror, a clean white cloak pinned at the shoulder, the halberd upright at his side, the helm under his arm. He stands very straight; a solemn, correct look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large and lowered slightly, the amber eyes looking up at the viewer, lips closed. Cold white light from one side, a cold pale silver gleam on the armour from the other. Foreground blur: the pale silver blade of a halberd and drifting cloud. He wears the white plate with its ring-of-fire emblem.

name: 缇莎
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_三_帝国.md:247
who: Tisha, a human girl of eleven, an errand child of the sky city who runs messages for the gods: small and thin, about 138 cm, wholly covered by her clothes, quick on her feet. Cherry-pink hair cut ear-length that streams backward when she runs. A pointed little face with very large emerald-green eyes that never blink, as if waiting for you to say it again. A small brass bell on her sash that rings as she runs. Barefoot. An eager, quick, listening air.
palette: cherry pink and emerald, white linen, blue sash, brass
casual: The errand children's clothes of the sky city: a short white linen tunic over long white linen leggings, a blue sash at the waist with a small brass bell hung from it, barefoot. She holds a stack of books in her arms; an eager, listening look.
private: Home clothes: a plain long-sleeved cream linen dress to the ankles, a knitted pale shawl, barefoot. She holds the stack of books to her chest; a sleepy, closed-mouth look.
battle: Ready to run a message: the white linen tunic and leggings, the blue sash tied tight, the little bell silenced with a knot of cloth, her hair tied back; she carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the runner's outfit: braced to run, one foot forward, the weight on the front leg, a rolled message gripped in one fist and the other arm swung back; she carries no weapon, a firm determined expression.
formal: For the feast: a clean white linen tunic and long leggings, the blue sash freshly pressed with the brass bell polished, her pink hair combed neat. She stands with her hands clasped in front; a shy, proud little look.
art: A close head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the very large emerald eyes wide open and unblinking at the viewer, lips closed. Soft white light from one side and a warm gold from the other. Foreground blur: a few drifting white clouds, the brass bell and a book spine. She wears the white linen tunic with the blue sash.

name: 芙丽达
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_三_帝国.md:303
who: Frida, a human woman of forty-six, a temple examiner of the Altar Island: tall, about 175 cm, thin and slightly bowed from a lifetime of bending over beasts. Grey-white hair in a single braid coiled at the nape. A long narrow face, water-blue eyes as still as the lake, which do not move when she looks. The tips of her fingers are stained yellow from blood, tinctures and lamp oil. A quiet, patient, unflinching air. No glasses.
face: FACE, as in the references: a long narrow woman's face of about forty-six, fine lines at the eyes and mouth, water-blue unmoving eyes, thin grey-white eyebrows, a straight nose, a closed thin mouth; skin shadows a cool tone.
build: 175 cm, tall and thin, stooped shoulders, a small B-cup, a narrow waist and slim hips, long stained hands.
palette: deep grey and pale silver, water blue, yellow stain, leather brown
casual: The temple's deep grey wool robe, closed down the front with buttons, the sleeves tied at the cuff with leather cords, over dark trousers and sturdy boots. At her belt, a lamp of pale silver whose shade is clear lake glass. A leather case on a strap at her hip holding small knives, vials and a thick notebook. She holds her stained fingers up near her chest; a still, unflinching look.
private: Resting clothes: a soft long-sleeved grey wool dress to the ankles, a plain knitted shawl, soft shoes, the braid loosened. She holds the notebook closed against her chest; a tired, distant look.
battle: Ready to face a beast: the grey robe with sleeves tied back, a heavy leather apron, leather gloves to the elbow. She holds the pale silver lamp high in her right hand, its light cold and white, and a short knife in her left, feet planted; a calm, fixed look.
formal: For the temple's rite: a clean deep grey long robe with a white collar, a pale silver chain at the neck, the braid coiled neatly, the lamp polished and hung at her belt. She holds the notebook closed in both hands before her; a grave, still look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the water-blue eyes looking at the viewer without moving, lips closed. Cold white lamplight from one side, a warm yellow glow on her stained fingers from the other. Foreground blur: the clear lamp glass and drifting mist. She wears the deep grey robe with the leather-tied sleeves.

name: 卡莉丝塔
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_三_帝国.md:454
who: Calista, a human woman of forty-one, a scholar who keeps the Northern Star tower's light: tall, about 173 cm, thin with one shoulder slightly lower from a lifetime of leaning on the brass star-tube. Long deep black hair in a loose braid that the tower winds unravel, with a blue-black sheen. A pale face that never sees the sun, very pale blue eyes that shine at night and squint by day. Fingers red with cold, the tips stained with star-chart ink. A quiet, absent, star-watching air.
build: 173 cm, tall and thin, one lower shoulder, a small B-cup, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: deep blue and fox-fur cream, ink black, pale silver, pale blue
casual: A scholar's deep blue wool robe closed down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, with a long cloak of fox fur worn fur-inward over it, dark boots. A leather pouch at her belt holding a rolled star chart, a pen and a piece of buckskin for cleaning lenses. She holds a brass star-tube in her right hand; a quiet, distant look.
private: Resting clothes: a soft long-sleeved dark blue wool dress to the ankles, a thick knitted grey shawl, soft shoes, the braid undone. She holds a rolled star chart against her chest; a sleepy, absent smile.
battle: Ready for the night watch: the deep blue robe belted tight, the fox cloak fastened, leather gloves, a woollen hood up. She holds the brass star-tube out in front of her in both hands like a staff, feet planted; she carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the night-watch outfit: standing upright and braced, the feet a little apart, the brass star-tube held out in front of her in both hands like a staff; she carries no weapon, a steady wary expression.
formal: For the tower's feast: a clean deep blue long robe with a white collar and a pale silver pin, the fox-fur cloak brushed, the braid pinned up neatly. She holds the star chart rolled in both hands; a calm, courteous look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the very pale blue eyes bright and looking at the viewer, lips closed. Cold starlight from one side, a faint warm lamp glow from the other. Foreground blur: pale light-motes, drifting snow and the brass tube. She wears the deep blue robe under the fox-fur cloak.

name: 盖乌斯
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_三_帝国.md:510
who: Gaius, a human man of thirty-six, a squad leader of the Northern Guard legion: medium height, about 180 cm, wide and solid. A square face reddened by cold, a flame-red full beard with frost hanging on it, short red hair, ice-blue eyes that squint when looking at ice. The two fingertips of his left hand (on the viewer's right when they face us) were lost to frostbite in his first winter on the frost line. A gruff, stoic, stubborn air. No glasses. Specifically, the ring finger and the little finger of his left hand (on the viewer's right when they face us) end short above the middle knuckle, the tips lost to frostbite and the stumps healed smooth and reddened; the two short fingers must show plainly in every panel where that hand is visible, including the panel where both hands are held out to warm, and the silver ring sits on the middle finger of that same hand.
build: 180 cm, wide and solid, thick shoulders and a deep chest.
palette: legion grey, frost white, flame red, ice blue
casual: The Northern Guard's grey armour under a bearskin cloak worn fur-outward, thick with frost, a legion short sword at his belt, and a pale silver ring engraved with his name on the hand with the missing fingertips (on the viewer's right when they face us). He holds the cloak closed at the chest; a gruff, hard look.
private: Resting clothes: a thick undyed wool sweater with a high neck, the sleeves rolled, wool trousers, fur-lined boots, no armour. He holds his hands out as if warming them; a quiet, tired grin through the frosted beard.
battle: Ready to hold the frost line: the grey legion armour with thin bone-silver rune-lines along the plates that keep a thin glow in the cold, the bearskin cloak fur-out, a legion helmet, a round shield on his left arm stamped with the ring of fire, the pale silver name ring on the left hand with the missing fingertips (on the viewer's right when they face us). He grips the legion short sword in his right hand held low, feet planted wide; a hard, stubborn look.
formal: For the legion's muster: the grey armour polished, a clean grey-blue sash, the bearskin cloak brushed, the helmet under his arm. He stands at attention; a grim, proud look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the ice-blue eyes narrowed at the viewer, lips closed in the frosted beard. Cold blue-white glare of ice from one side, a warm orange fire glow from the other. Foreground blur: blowing snow and frost crystals. He wears the grey armour under the frosted bearskin.

name: 古纳尔
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_三_帝国.md:566
who: Gunnar, a human man of sixty-three, the last hunter of the northern wastes: short, about 166 cm, thin and bowed. A face carved by wind and snow into a mass of deep lines, like old tree bark. A beard of pure white with ice caught in it. Pale gold eyes that squint to slits when looking at snow. Both ears are ordinary small human ears, round and set flat against the head, NEVER tall, long or pointed like an elf's; the only thing wrong with them is that the top of each ear is missing, cut off straight and level with the eyebrow as if sliced away by frost, leaving a short ear with a flat, slightly ragged, reddened upper edge. A silent, patient, gentle-stubborn air. No glasses. The hair is tucked back behind the ears so both short ears show in every panel.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old man's weathered face of about sixty-three, deeply carved with wrinkles, sunken cheeks, a long white beard, pale gold narrowed eyes with heavy folds, white eyebrows, a broad nose reddened by the cold, both ears small round human ears with the top sliced off flat and never pointed; skin shadows a ruddy tone.
build: 166 cm, short, thin and bowed, a lean wiry old man.
palette: snow white and fox fur, pale gold, antler bone, leather brown
casual: A hunting suit sewn of white fox fur worn fur-outward, so that he vanishes on snow, hood and mittens attached, leather straps at the waist and wrists, fur boots. A skinning knife at his belt and a leather pouch of dried meat. He holds an old bow whose back is the antler of a great stag, its string of deer sinew; a quiet, squinting look.
private: Resting clothes: a loose old wool shirt and a quilted grey vest, thick wool trousers, soft fur slippers, no hood. He holds a pouch of dried meat in both hands; a slow, gentle smile.
battle: Ready to hunt: the white fox suit with the hood up and the face half covered by a scarf of white fur, mittens off to bare fingers on the string. He draws the antler bow with an arrow nocked, the string at his cheek, feet planted; a calm, flat look.
formal: For the mining town's feast: a clean grey wool coat over a white fox-fur collar, a neat felt cap, the beard combed. He holds a plain walking stick upright in both hands; a courteous, shy smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the pale gold eyes squinting at the viewer, a faint kind smile in the white beard. Cold blue snow-light from one side and a warm gold from the other. Foreground blur: blowing snow and the curve of an antler bow. He wears the white fox fur hunting suit.

name: 客星城的宴席总管
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_三_帝国.md:807
who: The banquet steward of the sky city, a human man of about fifty, the ninth of his family to run the feasts: short and plump, about 160 cm, with a round face that creases his eyes to slits when he smiles. His hands never stop moving, as if seating people. Neatly oiled dark chestnut hair parted at the side, small shrewd brown eyes. A courteous, thorough, unhurried air. No glasses. He is unmistakably about fifty years old, not a young man: crow's feet at both eyes, deep folds running from the nose to the corners of the mouth, a soft double chin under the round face, a few grey strands at the temples. The hair is slicked flat with oil and combed to one side from a straight parting, lying close to the scalp, not fluffy or tousled.
build: 160 cm, short and plump, round belly, small quick hands.
palette: court white satin and cold silver, ink black, warm cream
casual: A court attendant's long white satin robe, closed down the front with buttons, the hem embroidered with a ring of fire and crossed keys, with a plain white sash; on the belt a thick ledger and a pen. He holds one hand out as if pointing out a seat; a courteous, shrewd smile.
private: Resting clothes: a loose old cream linen robe with the sleeves rolled, soft slippers, the ledger left off. He holds a cup in both hands; a tired, contented look.
battle: Ready for a crowded night: the white satin robe with the sleeves pinned back, the sash tight; he carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the steward's busy-night outfit: standing alert and braced, the feet apart, the thick ledger clutched against the chest in the left arm and a pen held up like a baton in the right hand; he carries no weapon, a shrewd firm expression.
formal: For the feast itself: the white satin robe immaculate with its silver ring-of-fire hem, a pale silver chain of office, a white satin cap, the ledger held in both hands. He stands very correct; a smooth, practised smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the small brown eyes looking at the viewer with a shrewd, courteous smile. Warm lamp light from one side, cold silver light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting white petals and the edge of a ledger. He wears the white satin robe.
